summary: User released 1000 dollars of USDT in a Binance P2P transaction after a Zelle payment appeared credited then the payment was reversed several days later leaving the user without the USDT or the payment
user_mistake: released USDT after accepting a reversible payment from an unknown P2P buyer
prevention: Accept payment methods with appropriate finality for P2P sales / Verify the payer identity matches the Binance P2P buyer before releasing USDT
